meta.name: insights
meta.description: Show session analytics, learning patterns, correction trends, heatmaps, and productivity metrics. Computes stats from project memory and session history. Use when asking for stats, statistics, progress, how am I doing, coding history, or dashboard.

copy.tagline: 查看学习进度、编码热图和生产力指标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想了解自己的编码习惯和学习进展
copy.tagline_en: View learning progress, coding heatmaps, and productivity metrics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand your coding habits and learning progress

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能分析你的编程会话，展示时长、修改文件数、纠正次数、学习模式等统计，并生成热力图和生产力指标。
howto.when: 当你询问“统计”、“进度”、“我做得怎么样”、“编码历史”或“仪表盘”等关键词时触发。

say.note: 展示当前会话的时长、修改文件数等摘要。

say.text: 我最近的学习模式是什么？
say.note: 列出学习类别和最常见的学习条目。
按类别展示纠正次数，并提示需要永久记录的学习点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze your coding sessions, showing duration, files modified, corrections, learning patterns, heatmaps, and productivity metrics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for stats, statistics, progress, how am I doing, coding history, or dashboard.

say_en.note: Displays summary of current session duration, edits, etc.

say_en.text: What are my recent learning patterns?
say_en.note: Lists top learning categories and most applied learnings.
Shows corrections by category and suggests permanent rules.
